description: This C# source file defines the class ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration, which implements IConfigureOptions<ResourceManagementOptions>. It configures resource manifests, including scripts and styles, for OrchardCore, with support for CDN URLs, integrity hashes, versions, and environment-based debug mode settings.

classes.name: ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration
classes.description: A class that configures resource management options, including resource manifests, CDN settings, and environment-based debug mode, for OrchardCore.

methods.name: ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies and path base.

methods.name: BuildManifest
methods.description: Creates and returns a ResourceManifest with scripts and styles, including CDN URLs, integrity hashes, and versions.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Applies the resource manifest and configures options like debug mode, CDN usage, and content base path based on environment and resource options.
